title: a16z Podcast: 'In the Eye of a Tornado' -- Views on Innovation from China

reader_summary.headline: No matter how one views Xiaomi -- and there are many ways to view it.
reader_summary.overview: No matter how one views Xiaomi -- and there are many ways to view it, for better or worse -- one thing is clear: It. Companies and countries that were once positioned as copycats or followers are becoming leaders, and in unexpected, non-obvious ways. For example, through scale, distribution, logistics, infrastructure, O2O, a different kind of ecommerce, mobile marketing, even design...

key_points.text: No matter how one views Xiaomi -- and there are many ways to view it, for better or worse -- one thing is clear: It.
